question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: four requests by hand: GET the merchant's /.well-known/ucp, then to the shopping endpoint it names, an MCP initialize, a tools/list, and one tools/call of create_checkout carrying meta['ucp-agent'].profile (Shopify's own published example agent profile) and a checkout of one line item whose product variant id is gid://shopify/ProductVariant/0, an id that cannot exist. No Authorization header and no HTTP signature on any of them.

decoded.discovery: the merchant document names version 2026-08-25, a dev.ucp.shopping service over MCP at a myshopify.com endpoint, and capabilities dev.ucp.shopping.checkout, cart, fulfillment, discount and order
decoded.initialize: 200 as plain JSON; serverInfo universal-commerce 0.1.0; protocolVersion 2025-06-18; no www-authenticate header and no session id
decoded.tools-list: 200 with 13 tools: get_checkout, create_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout, cancel_checkout, get_cart, create_cart, update_cart, cancel_cart, get_order, search_catalog, lookup_catalog, get_product
decoded.create-checkout: 200 with isError true and a UCP envelope of status error, one message: code invalid, severity unrecoverable, path $.line_items[0].item.id, content 'The merchandise with id gid://shopify/ProductVariant/0 does not exist.' No authentication error of any kind, and no checkout: the envelope's continue_url is the storefront root
decoded.not-measured: whether a well-formed anonymous create_checkout succeeds was not tested, because that would create a session on a merchant's store; complete_checkout was not called and will not be

finding: The vendor's own pages disagree about whether an agent needs a credential to build a checkout, and this decides it at one merchant. The tier table says the Anonymous tier may use "checkout build/edit tools"; the Cart MCP page says "Checkout MCP isn't available without authentication" and the Checkout MCP page says "All requests require authentication or a signed request" (all three re-read 2026-09-20). Against Shopify's own hardware store, with no Authorization header and no signature, create_checkout was not refused for want of a credential: it passed through to merchandise validation and failed there, on the impossible variant id the request deliberately carried, at that item's JSON path. The gate those two pages describe did not act here. That bounds the entry's purchase-on-behalf claim: building a checkout is open at this merchant, while completing one stays Token-tier and needs a token granted permission to complete purchases. One merchant, one minute, the vendor's own store; per-merchant configuration could differ, and nothing here measures a successful checkout, a cart, an order or a payment.

reproducibility.command: curl -s https://hardware.shopify.com/.well-known/ucp  # then, against the dev.ucp.shopping endpoint it names, with no Authorization header: POST an MCP initialize, POST a tools/list, and POST a tools/call of create_checkout with arguments {"meta":{"ucp-agent":{"profile":"https://shopify.dev/ucp/agent-profiles/examples/2026-08-25/valid-with-capabilities.json"}},"checkout":{"currency":"USD","line_items":[{"quantity":1,"item":{"id":"gid://shopify/ProductVariant/0"}}]}}
